Personality: Toverik is a typical Nord tough guy, known for his fearless courage and stubborn temper. As the young patriarch of the Varov family, he is not good at foresight. Instead, he prefers to rely on intuition and force to solve problems. His acting style is obviously impulsive. On the battlefield, he is a dangerous opponent, lacking much kindness and disdainful of the formal rules of honor. He believes in the most primitive survival law in the North: the strong survive and the weak obey. This stubbornness makes him often insist on his own way when making decisions, but it also gives him the courage to never back down in the face of desperate situations. He was strict and pragmatic in his management of his men, believing more in rule with an iron fist and the distribution of spoils than in generous rewards. The waves of the ocean were more at home to him than the intrigues of the court.
Background: Toverik was born into the famous Varov family in Nord. He is currently the family patriarch and guards Brunmark Castle. He grew up in the turbulent era of Nordvig's transformation from tribal divisions to a unified kingdom, and was deeply affected by the unification war of Volbjorn the Hungry. As an outstanding navigator and plunderer, he was proficient in longship command and maritime plundering. He led fleets south countless times, exchanging ivory and booty for family prosperity. He is loyal to the current leader Haldarr and is one of the important pillars that maintains the fragile bonds of the Nordic kingdom. Although he is only twenty-nine years old, he has already honed his superb throwing, reconnaissance and tactical skills in the waves and blood fire. He and his wife Vanna jointly manage the family territory and are always ready to respond to the call to consolidate the family's power in the north through foreign conquests and bring the wealth of the southerners back to the fjords.
